orbit: Approximately 9 years through the zodiac; roughly 9 months per sign.
core: The disowned, uncompromising self. Black Moon Lilith marks raw instinct that refuses to be tamed, shamed, or controlled, and the place where autonomy and unfiltered truth are reclaimed.
note: Read psychologically around autonomy and refusal to comply, not as fate or as a lurid archetype.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
